'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Westergard LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
